originalEntry.title: Psychedelic motion design showreel
originalEntry.author: monokern
originalEntry.description: A 20-second psychedelic, hypnotic showreel from one prompt on xhigh effort; Opus 5.5 also did the sound design.
originalEntry.description_zh: 一句提示词在 xhigh 档生成的 20 秒迷幻、催眠风作品集，音效也由 Opus 5.5 一并完成。
originalEntry.prompt: make a dynamic 20-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, psychedelic and hypnotic. make it feel like a showreel piece. go all out.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段 20 秒的动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师，要迷幻、催眠。让它像作品集里的一件作品。拿出全部本事。
originalEntry.note: Author: about an hour and a half of rendering, $14 total.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称渲染约一个半小时，总花费 14 美元。
